prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: approval design for Rakky Ride courier delivery review.
Input images: the attached screenshot is the current app and the exact map reference. Keep its actual Google map imagery and visible route in the upper portion. Do not invent, illustrate, simplify, or redraw the map. Remove the blue browser-comment outline and numbered marker.
Primary request: produce ONE beautiful complete mobile screen, flat front-facing portrait 405 x 844 logical pixels, no phone frame, no presentation title outside screen. Redesign the lower review sheet only in a compact white-forward premium ride-hailing UI. The user must approve before implementation.
Visual hierarchy: charcoal Inter-like text; forest green actions; white surfaces; silver hairline borders; soft mint information strip. Small type: screen heading15px, package title14px, field labels and body13px, fare16px, button14px. Small utility icons14–18px with comfortable 44px tap areas. No gradients, no huge headings, no emoji, no large illustration, no decorative logo. Precise20px side gutters and8–12px gaps, rounded top sheet20px, cards10px. Calm professionally designed compact controls.
Layout:
Upper32% of screen retains the REAL Google map from reference, route line and actual markers. Small44px circular white back button top left. No fake trip duration, driver, ETA, or distance.
Lower white sheet anchored to bottom, about68% screen height, small centered grab handle.
Header row exact title "Review delivery" at left; on right compact green "Courier" label with a tiny parcel outline.
Below: compact border-only package summary card, width full, small clean soft matte 3D cardboard parcel with green tape40px at left, exact main copy "Documents", subcopy "1 kg · Sealed package"; small outline edit icon on right with44px tap space.
Next a compact two-stop route timeline, green pickup circle and charcoal drop-off pin connected by thin dotted line. Labels13px muted "Pickup" and "Drop-off", addresses13px dark "RGV5+VC Somo, Nigeria" and "MCW8+VVR, Lagos–Ibadan Expy, Ofada". Allow at most2 lines for each address. No heavy gray filled blocks. Below route, a small recipient line using an outline person icon and exact copy "Recipient details" with "Name and phone added" as a muted13px secondary line. This is a design sample, do not reproduce the private phone or name from the reference.
Small soft mint strip with outline shield/key icon and title "Delivery code"13px medium. Exact description13px: "After booking, share the 6-digit code with your recipient." Keep this short and readable; no actual code displayed.
Bottom fixed action area, separated by a subtle thin divider and comfortable padding. First row label "Delivery fare"13px and right-aligned "₦14,597"16px semibold. Next row small wallet outline icon and "Wallet balance: ₦34,000"13px muted; another brief caption "Fare held when you place the order."13px muted. Full-width48px solid forest green primary button exact "Send package · ₦14,597"14px inverse label, small right arrow.
Ensure entire sheet and bottom action fit on the screen, balanced whitespace, small compact professional typography. Real functional design for an existing app. No promises of delivery guarantee or instant driver, no fake booking confirmed, no invented payment method switch because this is wallet-only. No illustrations replacing the real map. Clear legible text, no extra marketing paragraph. Approval mockup only.
